what: THE FIRST MINUTE. UI round 3 (11/2/26) made the machine, the start screen's picks and the hints toggle; UI 5 (11/3/26, asks 338 and 340, his 11/2 NO on the machine) made THE FEED: the loading screen is a camera's own feed, three made through the master rig, the pick in the game, all three on the VOTE tab; the picks restyled as the camera's own buttons. Every number the first minute reads is here. Words are draft:true attempts for WORDS.
